_about: The clinic's pipeline (docs/modes/clinic-design.md: the Mini-game quality pass Q1-Q7 over the Pipeline design P1-P13). One patient = waiting room -> diagnosis -> pharmacy (the belt) -> heal (a registered healing game, docs/clinic-heal-api.md) -> send-off. Read by js/clinic/pipeline.js in the browser and in Node (build/leak_clinic.mjs). Real Kutchi only where the family gave it (docs/kutchi-grammar-notes.md and the list at the top of the pipeline design): Muke {x} khape, ne, pela ... ne poi ..., the numbers, haa, na (G9: no is na, not nar), wadho/nindho (he-forms), Salamun alaykum, Aabhar aanjo, Achija. Everything in [brackets] is an English placeholder, shown grey italic. Never invent Kutchi.

kinds._about: P2: kinds of person, not names (the lesson). `who` = the waiting room's ladder word (man / woman / boy / girl: W4, Zafar); `age` = old / young for the adults (rung 2). `he` = a he-word for wadho/nindho (the she-forms are not confirmed). `elder` = the formal greeting. Every word here is an English placeholder, to record (the doctor's session, Round 4 Section G).

ladder_words._about: The waiting room's ladder words (W4). All English placeholders, to record (man, woman, young, old, tall, short, with, the colours, the baby, the child, bring in).

parts._about: Which parts diagnosis can land on, by the diagnosis level (P3: 6 -> 13 -> 19; the ailments decide which of them can be sore).

ailments._about: P3/P4: part -> game -> the prescription. `items` is the heal tray in the game's own ids and order (what the host would default to); `ask` is what the belt asks for, in priority order (level 1 asks the first one; the rest the doctor already has on the counter). `from` = the lowest diagnosis level it's drawn at. `say` = the doctor naming it.

waiting._about: P2 + Q3, rebuilt for clinic v2 (docs/modes/clinic-v2-design-sheets.md W; Zafar's W3/W4/CQ1/CQ2). The doctor leans out of his half-open door and calls; the child taps the TICK under the right person (it shakes if wrong, locks in if right); nobody walks until chosen. The level is the language ladder (W4): 1 man / woman / boy / girl; 2 + old / young; 3 + tall / short; 4 + a colour (of clothes); 5 + with the baby / with the child. Every ladder word is an English placeholder, to record. `people` = how many in the room per level (6 bench seats, then the standing spots by the door and the desk: 4, 6, 7, 8, 8; at level 5 the babies and children sitting with the grown-ups make it 9-10 in the room); `standing` = how many of them stand. mix: W1 one call; W3 the child calls them (speaking; kinds only, levels 2-3); W4 two calls in the called order with the comfort rings (level 3+).

diagnosis._about: P3 + Q3. D1 is taught at level 1 (the very first sessions: days.mix names it); D1 level 2 (was D1b) grades haa/na (Found it on haa, Next on na); D2 the bulk; D3 the check-up detective (clinic v2: from level 1, with only the right tool plus one; `cue` = each tool's first-time cue, English placeholders to record).

pharmacy._about: P4 + Q1: tap at every level. Clinic v2 (P): the items ride the painted belt on CB4c edge to edge (no hatches: they slide in from off-screen), the tray sits on the counter strip (pantry style), level 3 is a faster belt with the items closer together, and there is no timer (CQ5). The X-ray left the decoys (it only reads as English). `asks` = how many items the belt asks for; `onBelt` = dishes on the loop; `everyMs` = one enters every; `crossMs` = time to cross; `lookalikes` per asked item; `colourFrom` / `countFrom` / `orderFrom` = the level each joins.

sendoff._about: P6 + Q3, rebuilt for clinic v2 (docs/modes/clinic-v2-design-sheets.md E; CQ6): on CB5, the patient at the half-open front door, the doctor beside them. E1 (level 1): the patient's round face circle shows the feeling; pick the matching card of four (happy, sad, hot, cold). E2 (level 2): the patient SAYS it, no picture; pick the card; then the goodbye the doctor cues, in the scene (E2 and E3 merged: E3 names E2). Level 3: the feeling shows and the child picks WHAT HELPS (cold: the blanket, hot: the fan, sad: the apple); E4 (level 3): the child asks first ([How do you feel?]), with Nani's whisper the first time. Not happy at levels 1-2: one more thing (in the scene), then it ends happy.

feelings._about: The four feeling faces (CQ6: the same for everyone). `line` = what the patient says (English placeholders, to record: Mum's own words, e.g. 'Muke thadh lage' for cold, are to confirm); `face` = the flat stand-in (js/clinic/kit.js Kit.feelingFace).

cue.english: Say thank you to the doctor.

extras._about: Levels 1-2: one more thing when they're not happy (in the scene, not the sidebar: the feeling's help, the apple for sad; Mum: no sweets), then the question again, always ending happy.

items._about: Clinic v2 overrides on data/clinic.json's items (P.prepare merges them over it). The ids stay (the heal games' tray contracts); what changes is the picture (`standin`: a flat stand-in drawn by js/clinic/kit.js until the art) and the word. lollipop -> an apple (Mum: no sweets, E3/CQ13); paste -> the filling as a tube (P4); torch -> a torch that looks like one (D5).

unwell.kutchi: [I don't feel well. I don't know why.]
unwell.english: I don't feel well. I don't know why.

days._about: P8: a clinic morning. `mix` is one entry per session (the last repeats): how many patients, each stage's level, and the healing games to draw from (set 1, then set 2), never the same game twice in a morning. Session 1 is the tiny first-ever session (UX 7): one patient, a bench of two, D1, one item on a slow belt, H2 (the scrape), E1. Each later session adds one thing per stage. After a morning, a stage whose rows were all right goes up a level (max 3), per stage.

bot._about: build/leak_clinic.mjs: 500 rounds per stage per level per strategy; the whole patient at level 1 too.
